## Description

<!-- Describe the problem or requested improvement and why it matters. -->

## Requirements

<!-- List the required behavior, content, routes, locales, or acceptance criteria. Write "N/A" if none. -->

## Expected outcome

<!-- Describe the observable result when this issue is complete. -->

## Steps to reproduce

<!-- For bugs, provide numbered steps that reliably reproduce the problem. Write "N/A" when this section doesn't apply. -->

## Expected behavior

<!-- For bugs, describe what should happen. Write "N/A" when this section doesn't apply. -->

## Actual behavior

<!-- For bugs, describe what happens instead. Write "N/A" when this section doesn't apply. -->

## Environment

<!-- Include affected URLs, browser and version, operating system, device, locale, and other configuration details. Write "N/A" when this section doesn't apply. -->

## Relevant logs

<!-- Add relevant logs, screenshots, or error output with secrets and private data removed. Write "N/A" when this section doesn't apply. -->

## Technical details

<!-- Include affected routes, files, components, content, and implementation details. Write "N/A" when a detail does not apply. -->

## Model and review effort
